evaluation_improvement_plan_007.evidence: If a teacher who holds a professional service contract as provided in Sec. 1012.33 is not performing his or her duties in a satisfactory manner, the evaluator shall notify the teacher in writing of such determination... placed on performance probation and governed by the provisions of this section for ninety (90) calendar days... must be provided assistance and in-service training opportunities... recommend that the Board continue or terminate his or her employment contract... submit a written request for a hearing.

evaluation_consequences_008.evidence: Within fourteen (14) days after receiving the evaluator's recommendation, the district school superintendent must notify the teacher... whether the district school superintendent will recommend that the Board continue or terminate his or her employment contract.
